Excellent verbal communication and relationship-building abilities.

Title:

FRAML Compliance




 
Job Summary:
At CoBank, our Compliance Analyst supports the bank’s Anti-Money Laundering (AML) program, including handling Know Your Customer (KYC) and Beneficial Ownership processes.  Performs customer transaction monitoring across all products and services to identify suspicious activity requiring a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR).  Assists with initial Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) reviews, and escalates to OFAC lead as appropriate.   Assists in maintaining Compliance Program job aids and procedural documents, and updates permanent increases in customers’ deposit limits.  
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
The essential functions include, but are not limited to:

Processes new customer KYC applications for lending and cash management offerings. 
Reviews the accuracy of the customer’s AML Risk Score, prepared by noncredit services or the CoBank relationship manager, and makes revisions as appropriate.
Assists in validating prepared and/or updated AML Risk Scores to ensure that they are correct and in accordance with bank requirements. Updates existing AML Risk Scores based on customers’ foreign wire activity observed during transaction monitoring.
Assesses Beneficial Ownership documents and handles requests for additional information.
Conducts research and validation of entity data using appropriate internal and external data sources, including legal name, address, entity type, and ownership verification. 
Performs initial OFAC searches, identifies false positive hits, and escalates true hits to OFAC Lead. 
Performs customer transaction monitoring across all products and services to identify suspicious activity requiring a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR). 
Assists in performing periodic audits of new customer records to ensure all appropriate customer identity verification and KYC information has been collected and stored and that any advanced due diligence requirements based on the AML Risk Score have been addressed and documented.
Assists in reviewing and recommending improvements for internal processes, including forms/checklists, data collection methods, analyses and reporting.
Manages permanent increases in customers’ deposit limits.
Assists in updating Compliance Program documentation. 
Participates in special projects and performs other duties, as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, criminology, politics, economic crime management, forensic accounting, law or

The Nutanix PSIRT is a growing center of excellence dedicated to the security of our products and the trust of our customers. We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to join our team. This role will involve leading Center of Excellence initiatives, governance framework development, SIAM standards implementation, enablement programs, and cross-functional project coordination. The ideal candidate will have experience in enterprise governance, consulting delivery, operational transformation, SIAM frameworks, and stakeholder management, along with a passion for operational excellence and organizational enablement.
Job Title: Technical Project Manager
Location: Texas (450 N Freeport Pkwy 1300, Coppell, TX, 75019)
Duration: 6 Months Contract
Job Description
About the Role
Trilyon is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to design and stand up a Center of Excellence for Managed Service Provider (MSP) Excellence within a Global Technology Solutions organization. This is a builder’s engagement where the CoE does not yet exist, SIAM standards are undocumented, and playbooks are still in early stages.
The Technical Project Manager will define the CoE structure, establish governance standards and playbooks, build enablement programs for retained staff and vendors, and document all operational processes to ensure a smooth transition to permanent internal teams upon project completion.
This engagement carries executive support and a clear mandate to deliver. The Technical Project Manager will operate with the independence and structure of an experienced consulting practitioner — managing stakeholders, delivering to scope, and ensuring a clean handoff at engagement close.
What You’ll Do

Define the purpose, scope, operating model, and governance structure of the MSP Excellence CoE, including ownership boundaries and collaboration models with Provider Governance, Finance, and Data teams.
Establish standards council cadence and decision-making processes for approving SIAM standards, onboarding assets, and training curriculum.
Develop SIAM standards, process playbooks, and operating procedures that retained teams and vendors will follow.
Build reusable templates, checklists, and reference materials that can be maintained by internal teams over time.
Design and deliver training programs for SPOps teams covering SIAM principles, vendor governance expectations, and evidence standards.
Build onboarding materials for providers and team members to ensure consistency across the MSP ecosystem.
Conduct maturity assessments of current MSP governance operations and define future-state improvement roadmaps.
Document all CoE assets, standards, processes, and training materials in a format suitable for long-term operational ownership.
Support knowledge transfer activities for incoming permanent teams during the engagement period.

Required Skills & Experience

10+ years of experience in consulting or enterprise environments designing and operating Centers of Excellence, enablement functions, or capability development programs.
Demonstrated experience building governance standards, playbooks, and training programs for multi-provider managed services ecosystems.
Strong ability to create standards and playbooks that are practical, actionable, and aligned to organizational maturity.
Experience operating independently in contractor or consulting-style delivery engagements.
Strong facilitation, instructional design, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience delivering training programs for mixed-experience technical and operational audiences.
Strong documentation and operational transition management capabilities.
Ability to structure work independently, manage stakeholders, and deliver within defined scope and timelines.
ITIL, PMP, or equivalent certifications preferred.
Bachelor’s degree required.

Core Competencies

CoE design and operating model development
SIAM standards and playbook development
Enablement, training, and facilitation
Maturity assessment and roadmap development
Consulting delivery and transition management
Governance and operational excellence
